headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Boston Red Sox 2-1 in a closely contested game. Jameson Taillon led the Blue Jays' pitching staff with 4.0 innings pitched, 3 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Blake Treinen, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Isiah Kiner-Falefa, Kervin Castro, Hunter Greene, Jameson Taillon, Kyle Stowers, Daniel Susac, and Tyler Freeman.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Other notable trades include the Philadelphia Phillies trading Seth Johnson to the Athletics for Colby Thomas, and the Miami Marlins trading Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Boston Red Sox 2-1 in a closely contested game. Jameson Taillon led the Blue Jays' pitching staff with 4.0 innings pitched, 3 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Brent Suter pitched 3 strong innings with 3 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, allowing 1 earned run and striking out 7 batters.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. This move comes after initially being placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' lineup as the team continues to make moves ahead of the 2026 season.
